main.name: schedule_reminder
main.description: Set a one-shot reminder for yourself. Use it when work needs a later check. For periodic checks, schedule the next reminder after each check.

main.name: team_list
main.description: List active and dormant teams for the current project.

main.name: team_resume
main.description: Resume all or selected stopped teammates from a team in the current project. Already-running teammates remain as they are.

teammates.description: Teammate names or Pi session IDs within this team. Omit to resume all stopped teammates.

showOnHerdrPanes.description: Open visible Herdr panes for selected teammates. Defaults to false.

resumptionPrompt.description: Instructions added once to resumed teammates' conversation context. Does not change system prompts or independently start work.

main.name: team_add_teammates
main.description: Add teammates to an active team you own. Existing teammates continue their work.
main.promptSnippet: Add new teammates to a running team

team.description: Team name or persistent ID. Omit when exactly one owned active team exists.

model.description: Canonical provider/model id for this teammate.

thinking.description: Thinking level for this teammate. Defaults to xhigh.

inheritMainContext.description: Start with a clone of your context window rather than start fresh. Defaults to false.

canManageOwnTeams.description: Allow this teammate to create and manage teams of its own. Defaults to false.

showOnHerdrPane.description: Open a visible Herdr pane for this teammate. Defaults to false.

teammates.description: New teammate definitions to add. Existing Pi sessions cannot yet be attached.

main.name: team_send_message
main.description: Message teammates in teams you own.

targets.description: Team or teammate names or IDs. A team selects all its teammates. Names must be unique in your available teams. Use IDs to resolve duplicate names. Overlapping selections count once.

interrupt.description: True interrupts all selected recipients. A list uses the same names or IDs as targets and must select only message recipients. False or omitted interrupts none.

main.name: team_status
main.description: Set your own status for a team and/or read team statuses.

team.description: Team name or ID. Omit to read all teams, or to set your status when exactly one owned team exists.

main.name: get_context_window_usage
main.description: Get context-window use of selected teammates. Your own window's use is always included.

targets.description: Team or teammate names or IDs. A team selects all its teammates. Names must be unique in your available teams. Use IDs to resolve duplicate names. Overlapping selections count once. Omit or pass an empty list for only your own usage.

main.name: team_log
main.description: Inspect paged event logs for selected teammates or teams you own.

targets.description: Team or teammate names or IDs. A team selects all its teammates. Names must be unique in your available teams. Use IDs to resolve duplicate names. Overlapping selections count once. Omit for all teams you own.

kind.description: Filter to any of these normalized event kinds

search.description: Case-insensitive substring search over summary, teammate, direction, kind, and details

since.description: ISO timestamp filter; only entries at or after this time

limit.description: Max rows to return, default 20, maximum 100

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response. Keep the same targets and filters when paging.

main.name: team_shutdown
main.description: Stop a team and kill its teammate processes.

team.description: Team name or ID. Omit when exactly one owned active team exists.

main.name: team_spawn
main.description: You are automatically part of the team as main. Do not include yourself in teammates. Use team_resume to continue an existing team, or team_add_teammates to grow one.
main.promptSnippet: Spawn a versatile team of agents.
